variables.name: LDEM_4 shape-map image sample
variables.semantics: Detached label names the IMAGE object HEIGHT and states samples represent height relative to the 1,737,400 m reference-radius offset; the product description calls it a shape map (radius). Packed signed 16-bit little-endian sample values use scale 0.5 and offset 1,737,400. This transform has not been applied to decoded pixels.

qualityMetadata: The detached label declares MINIMUM -17758 and MAXIMUM 21008 for the uncompressed IMAGE object; these are label metadata, not independently recalculated pixel statistics.
The label does not declare MISSING_CONSTANT or MISSING_VALUE; fill and valid-sample rules remain unknown.
The label warns about possible artifacts at 45-degree latitude-band edges and says surface interpolation was used at higher resolutions to compensate for incomplete coverage.
